nodes.label: Paper-only / no-signals / lagged-data compliance moat
nodes.rationale: Paper-only simulation is the only defensible stand while SEBI throttles retail F&O; no real funds, no order routing, no cash prizes keeps the company outside broker-dealer and money-transmitter territory.

nodes.label: F1: signal/sizing copy ('Real edge... Size up', Half-Kelly, BUY/SELL fires)
nodes.rationale: Textbook personalized buy/sell + sizing recommendation: pierces the Lowe v. SEC publisher exclusion and trips SEBI RA Regulations; the single line between educational publisher and unregistered adviser.

nodes.label: F2: undelayed live Yahoo data served to India
nodes.rationale: Violates SEBI's lag rule for unlicensed data redistribution and Yahoo ToS; at first charge the site becomes a commercial redistributor of an unlicensed scrape. Fix: geo-gate India to EOD/lagged; license a clean feed.

nodes.label: F3: public hypothetical performance claims (accuracy %, Sharpe, win-rate, leaderboard)
nodes.rationale: Hypothetical/backtested performance on unrestricted retail pages draws SEC marketing-rule and FTC deception exposure (Online Trading Academy $362M); tag every figure hypothetical, kill the accuracy leaderboard, rank on mastery never edge.

nodes.label: 90-day compliance punch-list (before first charge)
nodes.rationale: Nine concrete pre-charge actions: rewrite F1 copy, geo-gate Yahoo, hypothetical tags, real legal pages, OCC-style risk interstitial with logged acknowledgments, lock /api/explain prompt, founder IP assignment, payment/tax setup, written feed quote.

nodes.label: DPDP/GDPR privacy + AI-training consent on the behavioral dataset
nodes.rationale: India's DPDP Act 2023 applies today; the policy must disclose decision traces used for AI training — an un-consented dataset is an un-sellable dataset at diligence.

nodes.label: Founder IP assignment (diligence make-or-break)
nodes.rationale: The most common diligence-killer for a 3-founder team is IP never formally assigned to the company; sign assignments covering the Black-Scholes engine, models and dataset now — fatal if missing at LOI.
